name: API Search
description: Generic REST API search. Supports keyword-search APIs and feed APIs via provider configs. Adding a new API source = adding JSON config, not code.

options.name: search_input
options.label: Search input source
options.description: Where search terms come from. 'keywords': use the keywords option. 'entity': read entity.keywords field (comma-separated or JSON array from CSV). 'entity_names': use entity.name as the search term.

options.name: keywords
options.label: Search keywords
options.description: Search mode: one API call per keyword. Feed mode: client-side filter on title/description. Only used when search_input='keywords'.

options.name: exclude_keywords
options.label: Exclude keywords
options.description: Items whose title contains these terms (case-insensitive) are filtered out.

options.name: max_results
options.label: Max results per keyword
options.description: Search mode: passed to API. Feed mode: max items after filtering.

options.name: providers
options.label: API Providers
options.description: Provider configurations. Each provider is a JSON object with: id, name, mode (search or feed), url, field_map, and optional auth. See README for schema.

options.name: provider_params
options.label: Provider parameters
options.description: Extra query params per provider. E.g. {"jobtech": {"municipality": "0180"}}

options.name: requests_per_minute
options.label: Rate limit (requests/min)
options.description: Global rate limit across all providers.

options.name: entity_production
options.label: Produce entities from results
options.description: When enabled, each approved item becomes its own entity for downstream steps (each gets scraped/analyzed independently). Handled at approval time by the skeleton.

options.name: entity_name_template
options.label: Entity name template
options.description: How to name produced entities. Use {field} placeholders: {title}, {company}, {source}, {url}. Only used when entity_production is enabled.

options.name: score_rules
options.label: Score rules
options.description: Scoring rules to flag high-signal items. Array of {field, patterns, score, label}. Field: item field to match (title, location, company). Patterns: substring matches (case-insensitive). Score: points to add. Items get _score (sum) and _signal (high/medium/low).
